description:
Remove the deprecated bit-buffer kernel compatibility surface — the `Kernel` trait, its `ScalarBackend` bridge impl, and `select_kernel()` in `crates/gf2-core/src/kernels/mod.rs` — once no consumer remains.

## Background

The field-capability classification (dev/active/6dc81018-field-capability-dispatch/classification.md §5) records this surface as superseded by `Backend` and `select_backend_for_size`; `canonical-cutover` is unsatisfied while the deprecated aliases remain.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `crates/gf2-core/src/kernels/mod.rs` contains no `Kernel` trait, no `ScalarBackend` bridge impl, and no `select_kernel()`, and no workspace consumer references them.
- [hard] REQ-02: The workspace CI contract passes after the removal.
title: Remove the deprecated bit-buffer Kernel compatibility surface
